title: The Door With Your Emblem
text: A door stands alone in the open hillside, frame and all, with nothing behind it but grass and wind. On it, in paint gone pale with age, are the arms of one of your Houses. Nobody living remembers having it made.

options.label: Its House opens the door it never built, unable to resist what waits behind its own arms.

outcomes.text: Behind it lies a room that was never built, full of things that were always theirs. On the table rests a sealed letter, marked to be opened only at home.
Beyond the door is a hallway of their own house as it will look when they are all dead. They slam it shut, but the sight stays with them.

options.label: Leave it shut. Some doors are better left unopened, even ones that bear your name.

outcomes.text: When you look back the door is gone. Its pale paint is on your hands now, and no amount of scrubbing will lift it. The next thing you fight will smell it on you.
